cast.name: 索菲·亚历山大-卡茨 Sophie Alexander-Katz

introduction: A new take on the body swap sub-genre, this comedy tells the story of Claudia (Sophie Alexander) and Antonio (Juan Manuel Bernal), a couple who have been married for 15 years. After all this time, their relationship has turned stale and meaningful communication is virtually nonexistent. One night, following a heated argument, a rare planetary alignment of Venus, Earth, and Mars causes a shocking transformation. Antonio's consciousness is now in Claudia's body and vice versa. The switch will give them an opportunity to empathize with the other person's daily life and reconnect with each other. A remake of the Brazilian film "If I Were You".
